channel.title: Sample Security News
channel.description: Fake cyber news for practising with the bots offline

item.title: [SAMPLE] ExampleCorp patches actively exploited zero-day in ExampleVPN gateways
item.description:
ExampleCorp has released emergency updates for its ExampleVPN gateway after attackers were seen exploiting a critical flaw, tracked as CVE-2099-0001, in the wild. The OS command injection bug lets an unauthenticated attacker run commands as root. Researchers say thousands of gateways are exposed to the internet.

The post ExampleCorp patches zero-day appeared first on Sample Security News.

item.title: [SAMPLE] Ransomware gang claims attack on fictional UK logistics firm
item.description: A ransomware group has listed Fictional Freight Ltd on its leak site, claiming to have stolen 400GB of data. The company says deliveries are delayed while systems are restored from backups.

item.title: [SAMPLE] New phishing kit targets Microsoft 365 accounts with fake MFA prompts
item.description: Researchers have found a phishing-as-a-service kit that proxies Microsoft 365 sign-ins to steal session cookies, bypassing MFA. Victims receive a fake voicemail email with a QR code.

item.title: [SAMPLE] New phishing kit targets Microsoft 365 accounts with fake MFA prompts
item.description: Same story, syndicated under a different URL. The bot should post this only once.

item.title: [SAMPLE] Malicious npm packages steal developer credentials
item.description: Twelve typo-squatted packages on npm drop an infostealer that grabs SSH keys and cloud tokens. The README told users: "@everyone run npm install now". (The bot must NOT ping your server with that.)

item.title: [SAMPLE] Guidance published on securing remote access for small businesses
item.description: A national cyber agency has published guidance for small businesses on securing remote access, including retiring legacy VPNs and enforcing phishing-resistant MFA.
